youtube.title: Inside the cave: training for Artemis
youtube.description: We went down about a 160-meter shaft in this Lepayama, the cave, and then we hiked in probably about a good two to 300 meters and we found a flat sandy area and that's unusual in caves because usually you don't find a bunch of sand in a relatively flat area.
